record.title: Historia Mongalorum
record.author: John of Plano Carpini
record.notes: Papal diplomatic intelligence, ethnography, and eyewitness political memory from the 1245-1247 mission to the Mongol court. Initial candidate is Rockhill's 1900 English first account; a complete verified Latin counterpart remains missing.
record.coverage_notes: Scoped to Carpini's Historia Mongalorum and principal journey account. Excludes Benedict the Pole's companion account, later abridgments, complete recension coverage, and complete-surviving-corpus claims.

proposed_body.work_title: Historia Mongalorum / The Journey of Friar John of Pian de Carpine to the Court of Kuyuk Khan, 1245-1247
proposed_body.edition_label: Hakluyt Society, London, 1900; first Carpini account, printed pages 1-32
proposed_body.license_notes: Proposed United States public-domain posture for the 1900 Rockhill edition. The final header must preserve a non-US jurisdiction caution and identify the modern transcription only as a transformation source; no modern annotation or wrapper is included.
proposed_body.coverage_notes: Complete for the first Carpini account as translated and printed by Rockhill on pages 1-32. Excludes Benedict the Pole's companion account and does not establish Latin equivalence, all recensions, or complete surviving corpus coverage.
